sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER THOUGHT ABOUT THE LAST FEW MOVIES THEY SAW. WHAT MOVIES HAVE YOU SEEN LATELY?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hello!
ParticipantA: You there?
ParticipantB: Yeah, sure.
ParticipantA: Hi, I'm calling because I was asked to chat with a stranger about movies. What's your name?
ParticipantB: I'm Sarah.
ParticipantA: Oh, nice to meet you. I'm Mark.
ParticipantB: Nice to meet you too, Mark.
ParticipantA: So, what movies have you seen lately?
ParticipantB: Well, I just saw *Dune: Part Two* and *The Fall Guy*.
ParticipantA: Oh, cool. I saw those, too. What did you think?
ParticipantB: I thought *Dune* was amazing, honestly. The visuals were insane.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I thought that was great, but I hated the second half a bit.
ParticipantB: Really? Why?
ParticipantA: Well, the plot got a little muddy. It felt like it dragged on for too long.
ParticipantB: Hmm, I actually loved the pacing. It built up so much tension.
ParticipantA: Oh, really? That's interesting. I guess I just prefer shorter stories sometimes.
ParticipantB: Yeah, me too, but this one just kept pulling me in.
ParticipantA: Well, I guess everyone sees it differently. What about *The Fall Guy*? Did you like that?
ParticipantB: Oh, that was fun! I loved it with Ryan Gosling and Emily Blunt.
ParticipantA: Yeah, that was a fun one. Very light.
ParticipantB: Definitely. It was a nice escape from everything else.
ParticipantA: True. Hey, you work as a mechanic, right? Do you like action movies or something else?
ParticipantB: Yeah, I'm a mechanic. I actually prefer stuff that makes sense mechanically.
ParticipantA: Oh, really? That's cool. I'm a teacher, so I get asked a lot about movies.
ParticipantB: Oh, really? What do you usually tell people?
ParticipantA: Well, I tell them that if the science is wrong, it bugs me. Like in *Dune*, the suit mechanics were a little off.
ParticipantB: Haha, yeah. There was that scene where the air ran out?
ParticipantA: Exactly! A guy in a pressurized suit breathing like he's in a vacuum? No way.
ParticipantB: Yeah, that doesn't make any sense. I told my brother about it.
ParticipantA: Oh? What did he say?
ParticipantB: He said, "Just go with the flow, Mark." But I can't get past it.
ParticipantA: Haha, fair point. My brother-in-law is a doctor, he'd say the same thing.
ParticipantB: Yeah, he's the same way. Always fact-checking.
ParticipantA: Well, I guess for teachers, you have to balance the story with the truth sometimes.
ParticipantB: True. Anyway, thanks for chatting. I really liked hearing your take.
ParticipantA: Thanks for yours, Sarah. It was fun talking.
ParticipantB: Yeah, you too. Good luck with your teaching!
ParticipantA: Thanks! Bye.
ParticipantB: Bye.
